S社の企画部では交通費申請システムの導入を検討している。企画部のAさんは，上司のB課長から“先日のシステム導入検討会の内容をまとめてほしい。まずは，交通費申請に関する現在の問題点とシステムへの要望を整理して，システムがもつべき機能を洗い出すことから始めてはどうだろうか。そして，システム導入の目的を明確にしていくことが大切だね。”との指示を受けた。システム導入検討会のメモは，次のとおりである。

〔システム導入検討会のメモ〕
(1) 利用区間と申請された金額が正しいかどうかの確認に，最も多くの時間を掛けている。
(2) 市販のソフトウェアを利用すれば，システム導入費用が安くなるはずである。
(3) 数日分をまとめて申請できる方法があってもよい。
(4) 申請書類に記入するべき項目が記入されていないなどの書類の不備が多い。
(5) 申請書類の計算ミスが多くて，承認までに時間が掛かっている。
(6) システム導入後も，申請書類の不備やミスは本人が修正して再度提出する。
(7) 過去に申請したデータを再利用して申請したい。
(8) 申請後に申請した交通費がいつ支払われるのかが分かるとよい。
(9) システム導入時には説明会を開いてほしい。

S公司的企划部正在研究引入交通费申请系统。企划部的A先生接到上司B科长的指示：“希望你把前几天系统引入研讨会的内容整理一下。首先，不妨从整理交通费申请方面当前的问题点和对系统的需求、梳理出系统应具备的功能开始，你看如何。然后，明确系统引入的目的这一点很重要。”系统引入研讨会的备忘录如下。

〔系统引入研讨会备忘录〕
(1) 在确认使用区间与所申请的金额是否正确上花费的时间最多。
(2) 如果利用市售软件，系统引入费用应该会变得更便宜。
(3) 也可以有一种能够把数日份汇总起来一并申请的方法。
(4) 申请文件中应填写的项目未填写等文件不完备的情况很多。
(5) 申请文件的计算错误很多，导致审批耗费时间。
(6) 即使在系统引入之后，申请文件的不完备和错误也由本人修改后再次提交。
(7) 希望能够再利用过去申请过的数据来进行申请。
(8) 如果在申请后能够知道所申请的交通费何时支付就好了。
(9) 希望在系统引入时召开说明会。

The planning department of Company S is considering the introduction of a travel expense application system. Mr. A of the planning department received the following instruction from his supervisor, Section Chief B: “I would like you to summarize the content of the other day's system introduction review meeting. To begin with, how about starting by organizing the current problems concerning travel expense applications and the requests for the system, and identifying the functions that the system should have? And then, it is important to clarify the purpose of introducing the system.” The memo from the system introduction review meeting is as follows.

[System Introduction Review Meeting Memo]
(1) The most time is spent on checking whether the route section used and the amount applied for are correct.
(2) If commercially available software is used, the cost of introducing the system should become lower.
(3) It would be good to have a method for applying for several days' worth at once.
(4) There are many deficiencies in the application documents, such as items that should be filled in not being filled in.
(5) There are many calculation errors in application documents, so approval takes a long time.
(6) Even after the system is introduced, deficiencies and errors in application documents are to be corrected by the person concerned and resubmitted.
(7) We want to be able to apply by reusing data from past applications.
(8) It would be good if, after applying, we could know when the travel expenses applied for will be paid.
(9) We would like a briefing session to be held when the system is introduced.

企業向け研修サービス会社のA社では、次の研修サービスの概要を要件とした研修申込受付システム（以下、研修システムという）の開発をソフトウェア開発業者に委託した。A社の事務担当Bさんは、研修システムの受入れテストを担当することになった。受入れテストには研修サービスの概要のとおり、表1に示す研修コースをテストデータとして使用する。

〔研修サービスの概要〕
(1) 研修の申込みは、顧客企業の申込責任者が取りまとめて行う。顧客企業には、会員企業（以下、会員という）と、非会員である一般企業（以下、一般という）がある。

(3) 開講日の翌月第1営業日に申込責任者ごとに前月の受講料とテキスト代を記載した請求明細書を作成し、研修代金として顧客企業に請求する。
(4) 開講日の3営業日前（開講日を含まない）までに申込みの取消しをせずに、開講日当日に欠席をした申込者は欠席扱いとし、テキスト代は請求せず受講料を請求する。開講日の3営業日前までに取り消した申込者は取消扱いとし、受講料及びテキスト代は請求しない。

③ ①と②の両方に該当するときは、それぞれのコースの受講料を20%割り引く。

〔培训服务概要〕
(1) 培训的报名由客户企业的报名负责人汇总后统一办理。客户企业分为会员企业（以下称会员）和非会员的普通企业（以下称普通）。
(2) 培训费用因培训课程而异，除课程费用外，还分为收取教材费的课程和不收取教材费的课程。
(3) 在开课日次月的第1个工作日，按报名负责人分别编制记载了上月课程费用和教材费的收费明细单，作为培训费用向客户企业收取。

(5) 课程费用设有折扣制度。作为其适用条件，设定了下述①～③。教材费不适用折扣。课程费用的折扣处理在编制收费明细单时进行。
① 属于会员的报名者，课程费用折扣10%。
② 对于同一报名者，若存在同一月份开课的多门课程的收费，则各门课程的课程费用折扣10%。
③ 同时符合①和②时，各门课程的课程费用折扣20%。

Company A, a company that provides training services for corporations, outsourced to a software development vendor the development of a training application reception system (hereinafter, the training system), whose requirements are the following outline of the training services. Mr. B, an administrative staff member of Company A, was put in charge of the acceptance test of the training system. For the acceptance test, in accordance with the outline of the training services, the training courses shown in Table 1 are used as test data.

[Outline of the Training Services]
(1) Applications for training are consolidated and submitted by the application manager of the customer company. Customer companies consist of member companies (hereinafter, members) and non-member general companies (hereinafter, general).
(2) The training charge differs by training course, and, separately from the tuition fee, there are courses for which a textbook fee is charged and courses for which no textbook fee is charged.
(3) On the first business day of the month following the start date, a billing statement listing the previous month's tuition fees and textbook fees is created for each application manager, and it is billed to the customer company as the training charge.
(4) An applicant who does not cancel the application by 3 business days before the start date (not including the start date) and is absent on the day of the start date is treated as absent; the textbook fee is not charged, but the tuition fee is charged. An applicant who cancels by 3 business days before the start date is treated as cancelled, and neither the tuition fee nor the textbook fee is charged.
(5) A discount system applies to the tuition fee. The following ① to ③ are set as the conditions for applying it. No discount is applied to the textbook fee. Discount processing of the tuition fee is performed when the billing statement is created.
① For an applicant who is a member, the tuition fee is discounted by 10%.
② When, for the same applicant, there are charges for multiple courses that started in the same month, the tuition fee of each of those courses is discounted by 10%.
③ When both ① and ② apply, the tuition fee of each of those courses is discounted by 20%.

商事会社のP社は，事務所が複数のビルに点在している。そこで，業務効率の向上を目的として，事務所を1か所に統合することになった。このために事務所統合プロジェクトが発足し，総務部のAさんがプロジェクトリーダになった。入社2年目のBさんは，Aさんの指導の下で，複数ある会議室の予約に用いる会議室予約システム（以下，予約システムという）の導入責任者になった。Bさんは，会議室の予約に関する要件をまとめた。

〔会議室の予約に関する要件〕
(1) P社には，営業部，総務部，経理部，情報システム部など，複数の部署があり，これまで部署ごとに会議室を設けていた。統合後は会議室を複数の部署で共有して使用する。
(2) 会議室には，一般用会議室と来賓用会議室がある。
(3) 一般用会議室は，全従業員が予約できる。
(4) 来賓用会議室は，従業員の役職で予約の可否を判定する。判定基準は，現在決まっていない。

事務所統合プロジェクトでは，予約システムのRFPを作成することになった。BさんはAさんからこのRFPの作成を指示され，作成者，掲載事項，提出先などについて説明を受けた。

Therefore, with the aim of improving operational efficiency, it was decided to consolidate the offices into a single location. For this purpose, an office consolidation project was launched, and Mr. A of the general affairs department became the project leader. Under the guidance of Mr. A, Mr. B, who is in his second year with the company, became the person responsible for introducing the meeting room reservation system (hereafter called the reservation system) used to reserve the several meeting rooms. Mr. B compiled the requirements concerning meeting room reservations.

[Requirements concerning meeting room reservations]
(1) Company P has multiple departments, such as the sales department, the general affairs department, the accounting department, and the information systems department, and until now each department had set up its own meeting rooms. After the consolidation, the meeting rooms will be shared and used by multiple departments.
(2) The meeting rooms consist of general-purpose meeting rooms and guest meeting rooms.
(3) General-purpose meeting rooms can be reserved by all employees.
(4) For guest meeting rooms, whether a reservation is permitted is decided based on the employee's position. The criteria for that decision have not been determined at present.

In the office consolidation project, it was decided to create an RFP for the reservation system. Mr. B was instructed by Mr. A to create this RFP, and received an explanation about the author, the items to be included, the submission destinations, and so on.

At company A, an advertising agency, the settlement of travel expenses incurred during customer visits is carried out using the travel expense settlement vouchers (hereafter, vouchers) that applicants route to the accounting department.

[Current flow of the travel expense settlement process]
(1) The applicant fills in the voucher with the applicant name, employee number, expense category, customer number, use date, use section, amount, and total amount. After affixing a seal, the applicant routes it to the clerk.
(2) The clerk examines the content of the application and, if there are no errors, routes the voucher to the approver. If there are errors, the clerk sends the voucher back to the applicant.
(3) The approver makes the decision to approve or reject. If the content is appropriate, the approver approves it and routes it to the clerk. If the content is not appropriate, the approver rejects it and sends it back to the applicant.
(4) When a voucher is sent back in (2) or (3), the applicant corrects the voucher and routes it to the clerk again.
(5) The clerk collects the approved vouchers for that day routed from the approver, assigns voucher numbers, and routes them to the accounting department.
(6) The accounting staff performs payment processing for the approved vouchers routed from the clerk.

In order to carry out travel expense settlement efficiently, it was decided to use a database to build a travel expense settlement system (hereafter, the settlement system) with the functional requirements shown below.

[Part of the functional requirements of the settlement system]
(1) The user logs on with an employee number. Based on the employee number, the applicant name is extracted from the employee table and set as a common item on the application screen.
(2) As line items on the application screen, the customer number, use date, use section, and amount are entered. Line items for multiple customer visits can be entered in a single application. In addition, the system calculates the total amount, sets the expense category, and automatically assigns the voucher number. Here, travel expenses is automatically set as the expense category.
(3) After the application is submitted, the clerk performs an examination, and a notification is automatically sent to the approver. The approver selects approval or rejection on the decision screen.
(4) On the payment screen, approved applications are aggregated by employee, and the payment amount is calculated.
